og.alt: Time (@pyreon/time): A date is a string. Date math should be too.

hero.alt: Schematic: three calls cycle. add('2026-01-31', { months: 1 }) returns '2026-02-28', because the day clamps to the end of February. diff('2026-11-18', '2026-12-24', 'day') returns 36. toPlainDateTime at an instant for 09:00 in New York, read in Asia/Tokyo, returns '2026-11-18T23:00'. A panel lists the four value shapes: PlainDate, PlainTime, PlainDateTime and Instant, all strings or numbers.
